notes.title: v0.9.3 Released
notes.notes:
[h2]🧈 v0.9.3 Released - The Great Smoothening[/h2][p][b]Long time no transmission, pilots![/b] This update is all about performance. If your framerate doesn’t feel like it’s gliding across ice, I failed my ancestors. Test it, break it, report it - and keep the feedback coming![/p][h3]🛠️ Optimization Overdrive[/h3][list][*][p]Moved [b]bullet[/b] and [b]crystal[/b] logic into optimized pools - no more freeloading particles clogging up memory.[/p][/*][*][p]Centralized bullet processing so your PC doesn't cry every time you shoot 600 homing missles.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Crystals[/b] now spawn, magnetize, and sparkle without dragging the framerate into the void.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a nasty [b]tween memory leak[/b] (I’m looking at you, rogue animations).[/p][/*][*][p]Set up [b]proper collision masks[/b] because crashing into invisible things is only fun in real life.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🪲 Bug Hunt & Balance Patch[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed fast bullet bugs, crystal collection freeze, and more debug errors than I want to admit.[/p][/*][*][p]Gave [b]EXTREME mode[/b] the balance pass it deserved. It’s still brutal, but now in a [i]fair[/i] way (kind of)... well not really :) But better ... kind of :)[/p][/*][*][p]Sounds and labels for crystals now chill out thanks to [b]throttling[/b], because apparently too much bling [i]is[/i] a problem.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed debug junk that’s been squatting in the codebase since 0.1.
[/p][/*][/list][p]👨‍🚀 Over and out
- Boldi[/p]

notes.title: Update notes for v0.8.12 [ easy mode fine-tuning ]
notes.notes:
[b]v0.8.12 - Easy Mode Actually Means Easy Now[/b]

So, a few brave pilots reached out and said:  
[b]"Hey... why is Easy Mode bullying me?"[/b]

Fair point.  
I grew up in the pixelated trenches of the 80s, where games didn’t care about your feelings - only your reflexes ( and yeah, they were unfair most of the time ).  
But times have changed, and you're absolutely right: [b]Easy mode should be easy[/b]. Who am I to gatekeep your joy?

So, I’ve made some changes. Here’s what’s new in Easy mode:

[list]
[*] Enemies decided to stop being jerks (for the most part) and will no longer spit bullets at you just because you're nearby.
[*] They're a bit slower now, shoot fewer bullets, and take a coffee break between shots.
[*] You now get an [b]extra shield with each life[/b]. Because you deserve it.
[*] Your bullets hit harder now. Because if you’re gonna shoot stuff, it might as well explode properly.
[/list]
[b]These changes only apply to Easy mode. [/b]If you want the old-school challenge, Medium and Hard are still full of pain and regret.

Also, across the game:

[list]
[*] Fixed a few things that were confusing or misleading.
[*] Extended the duration of some timed bonuses (like Super Rapidfire) so you can enjoy the chaos longer.
[*] Squashed a few bugs that were crawling where they shouldn’t.
[/list]
Hopefully this makes the experience more fun, less frustrating, and a little more fair.

Stay safe out there, pilot 🛸  
And if you’re still struggling... well, there's always God Mode (just kidding... or am I 😉 ?).

P.S. I’m really grateful for the feedback - keep it coming! I’m reading everything.
Just keep in mind this is a side project for me, so it might take a bit to address things. Thanks for your patience and support ❤️

notes.title: 🚀 Tryü Sora Runs Flawlessly on Steam Deck! 🎮
notes.notes:
Great news for Steam Deck players! Tryü Sora has been tested on the device and runs perfectly without requiring any changes. The controls are fully intuitive, ensuring a seamless experience whether you're at home or on the go.

With performance this smooth, we’re optimistic about Steam Deck certification in the future. If you're a fan of retro space shooters, this is your chance to enjoy Tryü Sora anytime, anywhere!

Wishlist the game now and stay tuned for more updates! 🚀✨
